description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wattegama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420352
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their registration details, ownership information, extent, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
